notes: Small-talk and assistant FAQ intents. 'doc_query' is a routing class with no responses: messages classified as doc_query are answered from documents (RAG). Placeholders: {name}, {time}, {date}, {day}, {collections}.

responses: Hello {name}! 👋 What would you like to know today?
Hi {name}! Ask me anything about your company's documents.
Hey {name}! How can I help you today?

patterns: i will talk to you later
responses: Goodbye {name}! Come back any time.
See you later! Have a great day.
Bye! I'll be here whenever you need me.
You're welcome, {name}! 😊
Happy to help!
Any time! Is there anything else you'd like to know?

intents.description: Small talk about the bot's wellbeing
patterns: how is it going with you
responses: I'm doing great, thanks for asking! How can I help you?
All systems running smoothly! What can I do for you?

patterns: what kind of bot are you
are you a person or a bot
am i talking to a computer
responses: I'm ConvoAI, your company knowledge assistant. I answer questions using your organisation's documents and show you where each answer came from.
I'm ConvoAI, an AI assistant that runs on this computer. I search your company's documents to answer questions about policies, IT, products and more.

patterns: what kind of questions can you answer
what are you able to help with
show me what you can do
responses: I can answer questions from your company's documents (HR policies, IT guides, sales material and more) and cite the exact source. I can also chat, tell you the time or date, and listen if you use the mic. You can search: {collections}.

patterns: what technology are you built on
responses: I was built as an MCA project at Karnataka State Open University, using Python, Flask, NLTK, scikit-learn and a local language model running through Ollama.

patterns: how do i ask a question
show me how to use this
how should i use this chat
how do i talk to you
how do i get answers here
responses: Just type your question in plain English, such as "How many casual leaves do I get?". Choose a collection chip above the chat box to narrow the search, click a source chip under an answer to read the original passage, or tap the mic to speak.

patterns: what departments do you know about
what information do you have access to
what knowledge base do you have
what material have you been given
what areas can you answer about
which collections do i have access to
what files are in your knowledge base
responses: You can search these collections: {collections}. Pick one using the chips above the chat box, or search all of them at once.

patterns: how can i upload a file
how do i teach you something new
can you learn from my document
how to add a policy document
how do i update your knowledge
can i add a word document
how to index a web page
how does an admin add documents
add a new document to the knowledge base
how to feed you new documents
how can i add a url
responses: Administrators can add knowledge from Admin → Documents: upload PDF, Word, text or Markdown files, or paste a web page URL, then pick a collection. New documents can be searched within seconds, with no retraining needed.

patterns: i want to talk to a human
i want to talk to your manager
i need to speak with a human
put me through to a person
can i chat with a live agent
is there a human i can talk to
i'd rather talk to a person
responses: I can't transfer chats, but you can contact the relevant team directly. Ask me "How do I contact HR?" or "What is the IT helpdesk number?" and I'll look it up in the documents.
Great! What would you like to know next?
👍 Go ahead and ask your next question.
No problem. Let me know if you need anything else.
Okay! I'm here if you change your mind.
Thank you, {name}! That's kind of you. 😊
Glad I could help!

intents.description: User is unhappy with the bot
patterns: this is not what i asked
responses: Sorry about that, {name}. Could you rephrase the question or pick a specific collection? A thumbs-down on the answer also helps an admin find the gap.
I'm sorry that wasn't helpful. Try adding more detail, such as the department or document name, and I'll search again.
Why did the PDF go to therapy? It had too many unresolved references. 📄
I'd tell you a UDP joke, but you might not get it.
Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs. 🐛
😄 Glad you liked it!
Ha! Anything else I can help with?

patterns: can you tell me the time
responses: It's {time}.

patterns: which day of the week is it
responses: Today is {day}, {date}.
I can't check the weather because I work offline with your company's documents. A weather app will help there!

intents.description: Data privacy questions about the bot
patterns: do you send data to the internet
does my data leave this computer
who has access to my chats
is my data shared with anyone
do you upload my questions online
are you storing what i type
is it safe to ask here
responses: Everything runs on this computer. The language model, your documents and your chat history stay local, and nothing is sent to the internet. Administrators can see anonymised usage analytics to improve the assistant.

patterns: can i speak instead of typing
how do i talk using the mic
can you read it out loud
responses: Yes! Tap the 🎤 mic button to speak your question, and the 🔊 button on any answer to hear it read aloud. Voice works best in Chrome or Edge.

patterns: can i type in another language
responses: I currently work best in English. Multi-language support is planned as a future enhancement.
To start fresh, click **New chat** in the left panel. Your previous conversations stay in your history.
